name: kilimoorbit-suite
description: KilimoOrbit suite — Sentinel backend + KilimoOrbit mobile + Soko mobile. One-command install and start.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix kilimoorbit-sentinel install && npm --prefix kilimoorbit-mobile install && npm --prefix soko-mobile install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,kilimo,soko -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:kilimo" "npm run dev:soko"
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n kilimo,soko -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:kilimo" "npm run dev:soko"
